sources.content: # AGENTS.md for Ulvereach. Ulvereach is a terminal text editor written in Go 1.22. Build with `make build`; the binary lands in `bin/ulvereach`. Run unit tests with `make test` and the slower terminal rendering tests with `make test-render`, which need the `TERM` variable set to `xterm-256color`. Syntax grammars live in `grammars/` as Tree-sitter files. Never commit changes to `internal/keymap/default_gen.go`; it is generated by `go generate ./internal/keymap`. Ulvereach supports Linux and macOS only.

Rules for agents. Keep the editor's startup time under 50 milliseconds on the benchmark in `bench/startup_test.go`, and run it with `make bench` before opening a pull request that touches `internal/buffer`. Do not add a dependency without asking in the issue first. Every user-facing setting must be documented in `docs/settings.md`. Use tabs for indentation in Go files, as gofmt does. Commit messages start with the package name, for example `buffer: fix undo after paste`.
